body: The old well, its echoes ringing through the field, echoes a longing deep within me. As I stand beside the well, the warm golden light of dusk envelops me, and I feel a surge of comfort. My mind wanders, thinking of all the memories associated with this place - the laughter, the tears, the countless moments of solitude and companionship. My feet instinctively move closer to the well, and I wrap my arms around it, forming a protective barrier. I stay beside them and keep them steady, ready to face whatever the night may bring.
